title: “What pride tried to burn… God is rebuilding in ways I never imagined. 🔥✨ Sometimes He lets things fall so He can show us how only His hands can raise them again.”
paragraphs:
“What pride tried to burn… God is rebuilding in ways I never imagined. 🔥✨ Sometimes He lets things fall so He can show us how only His hands can raise them again.”
“If it collapsed, trust Him… restoration has already begun.”

“When pride comes, then comes disgrace, but with the humble is wisdom.” — Proverbs 11:2 (ESV)
“The Lord rebuilds Jerusalem; He gathers the exiles of Israel.” — Psalm 147:2 (NIV)
